aioverview.text:
Yes, AT&T permanently shut down its email-to-text and text-to-email services on June 17, 2025.

What Changed

Gateways Retired: AT&T discontinued its email-to-SMS ((at)txt.att.net) and email-to-MMS ((at)mms.att.net) domains.

Impacted Services: The shutdown applies to all AT&T Wireless, AT&T Business, FirstNet, and Cricket Wireless subscribers.

No Delivery: Emails sent to these gateways no longer deliver, and text-to-email routing from AT&T numbers is also disabled.

Why AT&T Made the Change

Security & Spam: The old open-relay system became a prime target for spam and "smishing" (SMS phishing) attacks.

Outdated Technology: AT&T phased out the legacy infrastructure in favor of modern, 10DLC-compliant (10-digit long code) and API-based messaging standards.

If you are looking for a workaround or alternative service to send text messages from an email client, let me know what kind of system or application you are trying to set up.

aioverview.markdown:
Yes, AT&T permanently shut down its email-to-text and text-to-email services on **June 17, 2025**. [Say Goodbye to Email-to-Text and Text-to-Email - AT&T](https://www.att.com/support/article/wireless/KM1061254/)

What Changed

  * **Gateways Retired:** AT&T discontinued its email-to-SMS (`(at)txt.att.net`) and email-to-MMS (`(at)mms.att.net`) domains.

  * **Impacted Services:** The shutdown applies to all AT&T Wireless, AT&T Business, FirstNet, and Cricket Wireless subscribers.

  * **No Delivery:** Emails sent to these gateways no longer deliver, and text-to-email routing from AT&T numbers is also disabled. Why AT&T Made the Change

  * **Security & Spam:** The old open-relay system became a prime target for spam and "smishing" (SMS phishing) attacks.

  * **Outdated Technology:** AT&T phased out the legacy infrastructure in favor of modern, 10DLC-compliant (10-digit long code) and API-based messaging standards.
